## 🚀 Feature Request: [Feature Name]

### **Description**
A clear and concise description of the requested improvement or feature.  
Example: *"Optimize GPU scheduling for Intel processors to reduce latency and improve performance."*

### **Why is this needed?**
Explain why this feature or improvement would be beneficial.  
Example: *"This tweak will help users with Intel graphics get better gaming and rendering performance."*

### **How should it work?**
Provide details on how the feature should function.  
Example: *"Adjust Windows registry settings to enable better resource allocation for GPU tasks."*

### **Additional Context**
Add any relevant **screenshots, code snippets, or links** that support your request.
